Owner: Head of Safety & Compliance + Mobile Security Lead
Description:
Hypothesis: Night-time cab drops or female employee commutes encounter unverified driver substitutions, escort guard absenteeism, or SOS button unresponsive states.

Proposed Change:
Zero-tolerance safety workflow: Enforce driver facial verification before trip start, mandatory OTP verification before car rolls, 1-tap SOS that immediately rings transport security room, and auto-call female employees after drop.

First 14 Days:
Immediate Day 1: Audit all reviews flagged with safety. Days 2-5: Review 24/7 security control room call routing. Days 6-14: Implement persistent lock-screen SOS widget.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Driver selfie match required every 12 hours or before shift.
2. SOS button in persistent notification bar accessible even on lock screen.
3. Drop confirmation auto-call triggers for female night shifts.
Metrics to Measure: SOS response SLA (< 30 seconds), zero unresolved safety escalations.

Description:
Hypothesis: SMS gateway throttling or corporate email spam filters cause delayed OTP delivery exceeding the 60-second in-app timeout, locking out employees before shifts.

Proposed Change:
Introduce multi-channel fallback: WhatsApp OTP and corporate email OTP backup if SMS is not received in 30 seconds; implement auto-reading OTP via SMS Retriever API.

First 14 Days:
Days 1-3: Review SMS provider delivery SLAs and failure codes. Days 4-8: Integrate WhatsApp Business OTP fallback endpoint. Days 9-14: Deploy client-side SMS retriever integration.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Multi-channel OTP option (WhatsApp / Email) appears automatically after 30s.
2. SMS Retriever API auto-populates OTP without manual copy-paste.
3. Clear troubleshooting guide linked directly on login screen.
Metrics to Measure: Login success rate on first attempt (target: > 95%), login complaint share in reviews (target: -75%).
